messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video where the person has blonde hair, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands in the middle of the road, turns her head, raises one arm to touch her hair, and places a hand on her hip.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot from behind and to the side of the subject.","clothing":"She wears a long-sleeved coral-pink top, a short pink pleated skirt, and black lace-up boots.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled up into a high ponytail.","identity":"A slim young woman with fair skin, shown mostly from the side and back.","scene":"An outdoor paved road under a concrete overpass, with orange-and-white construction barriers, a metal guardrail, trees, and a bright sky."},"uncertain":["The character's face is mostly turned away, so facial features are unclear.","The image has a stylized, possibly 3D-rendered look, so whether it is live action or CGI is unclear."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a rooftop with buildings and cranes to a road under a concrete overpass with construction barriers, guardrails, and trees, closely matching the reference. The woman remains in the same pose sequence, with the same pink top, pink skirt, black boots, and blonde ponytail. The lighting on her appears brighter and more consistent with the outdoor road scene.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original rooftop/construction scene with the reference road-under-overpass environment while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement unchanged, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Facial expression cannot be fully verified because the face is mostly turned away.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin tone appears slightly lighter in the output than in the source.
